description: Saves one exact setting exposed by HGRWeb Supplier configuration. No supported setting enables, disables, suspends or re-enables a supplier. Requires confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true because source settings can affect many listings. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally.

Key.description: Source setting key exposed by HGRWeb Supplier configuration. 1=Markup percentage, 2=Dispatch days, 3=Monitor stock, 4=Monitor price, 5=Monitor price decreases, 6=Maximum monitored price-decrease percentage, 7=Default description template, 8=Default delivery policy, 9=Returns policy, 10=Global Shipping Program, 11=Shipping business policy, 12=Return business policy, 13=Payment business policy, 14=Item location city, 15=Item location postcode, 16=Item location country, 17=Amazon Prime-only products, 19=Amazon maximum delivery days, 29=Aosom business links, 30=Fixed markup, 31-37 and 47-48=GPSR responsible-person details, 38-44 and 49-50=GPSR manufacturer details, 45=Responsible-person override mode, 46=Manufacturer override mode, 51=Adjusted supplier cost percentage, 52=Fixed adjusted supplier cost, 53=Action when shipping cost is unknown, 54=Fixed shipping cost when unknown. No key enables, disables, suspends or re-enables a supplier.

SourceId.description: Exact source identifier returned by the HGR sources endpoint.

Value.description: Serialized value required by Key. Boolean keys 3, 4, 5, 10, 17 and 29 use 0=false or 1=true. Numeric keys 1, 2, 6, 19, 30, 51, 52 and 54 use an invariant numeric string. Keys 45 and 46 use 0=apply only when original data is absent or 1=always override. Key 53 uses 0=mark out of stock or 1=use the fixed shipping price from key 54. Key 9 accepts Days_14, Days_30, Days_60 or No_Returns. Keys 7, 11, 12 and 13 require an existing template or marketplace policy identifier returned by the corresponding read tool; never invent an identifier. Key 16 uses a country code. Text and GPSR keys use their literal text value.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_save_source_setting
title: Save Source Setting
